title: Training User Simulators with Latent Intrinsic Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2610.13617v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: User simulators are gaining attention as environments to train LLM assistants that can better cope with the nuances of multi-turn conversations with real users. Prior work on user simulation has emphasized generating realistic user utterances, leaving unexplored their potential as a source of direct feedback on the assistant's responses. Such evaluation signals may not be explicitly communicated in language, but can instead reside in the latent reasoning of users. In this work, we introduce user simulators with intrinsic feedback, namely, models equipped with latent evaluation states: internal thoughts, reactions, and scalar ratings that evaluate the assistant from a first-person user perspective at each conversation turn. translated_title: 基于潜在内在反馈训练用户模拟器
translated_abstract: 用户模拟器作为训练大语言模型（LLM）助手的环境正受到越来越多的关注，这些助手能够更好地应对与真实用户进行多轮对话时的细微差别。以往关于用户模拟的研究侧重于生成逼真的用户话语，但尚未探索其作为对助手回复提供直接反馈来源的潜力。这类评估信号可能不会以语言形式显式表达，而是存在于用户的潜在推理之中。在本工作中，我们引入了具有内在反馈的用户模拟器，即配备了潜在评估状态的模型：这些状态包括内部想法、反应和标量评分，能够在每轮对话中以第一人称用户视角对助手进行评估。我们使用真实用户与助手之间的交互日志来训练基于大语言模型的模拟器，并证明与通过提示构建的模拟器基线相比，内在反馈提升了模拟的真实性和批判行为。
tldr: 提出了一种具有潜在内在反馈的用户模拟器，通过在每轮对话中以第一人称视角生成内部想法、反应和评分等潜在评估状态来评估助手，显著提升了模拟的真实性和对助手回复的批判能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces user simulators with latent intrinsic feedback—equipped with internal thoughts, reactions, and scalar ratings that evaluate assistants from a first-person user perspective at each turn—demonstrating improved simulation realism and critiquing behaviors over prompted simulator baselines.
